dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts the Brampton Plan-Schedule 4 Road ROW width hierarchy for Heritage Heights.

Heritage Heights Right-of-Way (ROW) widths identify the planned street corridor widths within the Heritage Heights community. These widths are intended to accommodate future transportation infrastructure, transit, active transportation facilities, utilities, and public realm improvements required to support the area's planned growth and development.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
